captures.name: advanced-filter

captures.caption: Copy to stays greyed until Copy to another location is selected.

captures.name: arrange-windows
captures.alt: The Arrange Windows dialog with Tiled selected among Tiled, Horizontal, Vertical and Cascade, and the Windows of active workbook check box clear.

captures.name: consolidate-dialog
captures.alt: The Consolidate dialog with Function set to Sum, an empty Reference box, an empty All references list, and the Top row, Left column and Create links to source data check boxes clear.

captures.name: create-pivottable
captures.alt: The PivotTable from table or range dialog, with Table/Range set to Sheet1!$A$1:$C$4, New Worksheet selected, and Add this data to the Data Model clear.

captures.name: create-table
captures.alt: The Create Table dialog, with the data range $A$1:$C$4 and My table has headers ticked.
captures.caption: Ctrl+T opens it on the current region; the check box decides whether row 1 holds headers.

captures.name: custom-views
captures.alt: The Custom Views dialog with an empty Views list, Show and Delete greyed out, and Close and Add available.
captures.caption: The list is empty until Add saves the first view of the sheet.

captures.name: data-validation-dialog
captures.alt: The Excel Data Validation dialog on its Settings tab, with the Input Message and Error Alert tabs beside it.
captures.caption: Opened on a cell without a rule, so Allow reads Any value; Clear All removes a rule.

captures.name: define-name

captures.caption: Excel proposes the top-left label as the name and the selection as the reference.

captures.name: error-checking
captures.alt: The Error Checking dialog for cell B2 holding =A2/A3, titled Divide by Zero Error, with Help on this Error, Show Calculation Steps, Ignore Error and Edit in Formula Bar.

captures.alt: The Developer tab in Excel for Mac.

captures.name: format-cells-alignment
captures.alt: The Format Cells dialog on the Alignment tab, with Horizontal set to General, Vertical set to Bottom, the Wrap text, Shrink to fit and Merge cells boxes clear, and the Orientation dial at 0 degrees.
captures.caption: Wrap text and Merge cells live here, under Text control.

captures.name: format-cells-border
captures.alt: The Format Cells dialog on the Border tab, with the line Style list and Color on the left, the None, Outline and Inside presets on top, and the border preview with its buttons.
captures.caption: Pick a line style first, then a preset or a side of the preview.

captures.name: format-cells-dialog
captures.alt: The Format Cells dialog on its Number tab, showing the six tabs across the top, the Category list from General down to Custom, and the Sample box on the right.
captures.caption: Special and Custom sit at the bottom of the Category list; neither has a ribbon button.

captures.name: format-cells-fill
captures.alt: The Format Cells dialog on the Fill tab, with the Background Color palette, the No Color button, Fill Effects, More Colors, and the Pattern Color and Pattern Style lists.
captures.caption: No Color removes a fill; the Sample box shows the result before OK.

captures.name: format-cells-font
captures.alt: The Format Cells dialog open on the Font tab, showing the six tabs across the top, the Font, Font style and Size lists, Underline, Color, the Effects check boxes and the Preview box.
captures.caption: Font style, Size, Underline and Color all change in one trip through this tab.

captures.name: format-cells-protection
captures.alt: The Format Cells dialog on the Protection tab, with Locked ticked, Hidden clear, and the note that both take effect only once the sheet is protected.
captures.caption: Every cell starts Locked; the lock does nothing until Protect Sheet is applied.

captures.name: goal-seek-dialog
captures.alt: The Excel Goal Seek dialog, with Set cell reading F16 and the To value and By changing cell boxes empty.
captures.caption: Set cell arrives holding the selected cell; By changing cell must hold a value, not a formula.

captures.name: macro-dialog
captures.alt: The Macro dialog listing the macros available to run in the workbook.
captures.caption: The same list opens with Alt+F8; a macro missing here is in another workbook or is not a Sub without arguments.

captures.name: new-formatting-rule
captures.alt: The New Formatting Rule dialog in Excel for Mac.
captures.caption: Style controls which settings appear in the New Formatting Rule dialog.

captures.name: page-setup-dialog
captures.alt: The Excel Page Setup dialog on its Page tab, with Portrait selected, Adjust to 100 percent, the paper size, and the print quality.
captures.caption: Orientation, Scaling and Paper size sit on the Page tab; Margins, Header/Footer and Sheet are the other three.

captures.name: paste-special
captures.alt: The Paste Special dialog with All selected under Paste and None under Operation, and the Skip blanks and Transpose check boxes clear.

captures.name: protect-sheet
captures.alt: The Protect Sheet dialog with an empty password box, Protect worksheet and contents of locked cells ticked, and only Select locked cells and Select unlocked cells ticked in the list.
captures.caption: Use AutoFilter is clear when the dialog opens; tick it to keep filters usable.

captures.name: record-macro-dialog
captures.alt: The Record Macro dialog, with Macro name, Shortcut key, Store macro in, and Description.
captures.caption: The name takes no spaces; Store macro in decides which workbook keeps the code.

captures.name: scenario-manager
captures.alt: The Excel Scenario Manager dialog on a sheet with no scenarios, with Add available and the other buttons greyed out.
captures.caption: Show, Delete, Edit and Summary stay greyed until the first scenario exists.

captures.name: sort-dialog
captures.alt: The Sort dialog with one Sort by level, Sort On set to Cell Values, Order set to A to Z, and My data has headers ticked.
captures.caption: Add Level adds a second key; levels sort from the top row down.

captures.name: subtotal-dialog
captures.alt: The Excel Subtotal dialog, with At each change in set to Region, Use function set to Sum, and Revenue ticked in the Add subtotal to list.
captures.caption: At each change in decides where a group ends, and Add subtotal to decides which columns get a total.

captures.name: text-to-columns
captures.alt: Step 1 of 3 of the Convert Text to Columns Wizard, with Delimited selected, Fixed width as the other choice, and a preview of the selected data.
captures.caption: Step 1 picks how the fields are separated; steps 2 and 3 set the delimiter and the column formats.
